props.headline: Deal of the Week
props.subhead: Featured trucks, trailers, parts and service offers, refreshed every week across our Florida locations.

props.text:
Every week we put a handful of units, parts and service offers out front. Some weeks it's a new International spec'd and ready to work, some weeks it's a used trailer coming off trade, sometimes it's a parts or PM special for fleets.

Deals move fast and quantities are limited. Call 800.741.7566, mention the Deal of the Week, and we'll confirm what's still available and hold it for you.

rows.label: What it is
rows.text: A weekly set of featured specials from Sun State International Trucks and Sun State Trailers: one truck, one trailer, and one parts or service offer.

rows.label: How often it changes
rows.text: Refreshed every week, and each offer runs only while that unit or part is available.

rows.label: How to claim
rows.text: Call 800-741-7566 or message us, mention the Deal of the Week, and we will confirm availability and hold it.

rows.label: Where
rows.text: Tampa (6020 Adamo Drive), Davenport (41609 Hwy 27), Sarasota (1000 Sarasota Center Blvd.) and Brooksville (17127 Runway Drive), Florida.

rows.label: Financing
rows.text: Available with minimum down payment and approved credit through BMO Harris Bank, Navistar Financial and other sources; parts, accessories, insurance and extended coverage can be included.

rows.label: Price terms
rows.text: Prices and availability are subject to change without notice; mistakenly posted prices or options do not obligate us to honor them.

items.q: How often do the deals change?
items.a: Featured deals are refreshed weekly. Offers run while the featured unit or part is available, so call to confirm a deal is still live before you drive out.

items.q: How do I claim a Deal of the Week?
items.a: Call 800-741-7566, mention the Deal of the Week and the unit or part you saw, and a salesperson or parts advisor will confirm availability and hold it for you. You can also send a message through our contact page.

items.q: Can I finance a Deal of the Week unit?
items.a: Yes. With a minimum down payment and approved credit you can arrange credit financing through BMO Harris Bank, Navistar Financial or our other financing sources, and roll parts, accessories, insurance and extended coverage into one monthly payment.

items.q: Do the deals apply at every location?
items.a: Unit deals are tied to the location holding that unit, in Tampa, Davenport or Sarasota. Parts specials are available at our Tampa, Brooksville and Aftermarket parts counters and through the online parts store.

Prices and availability are subject to change without notice, and mistakenly posted prices or options do not obligate us to those incorrect prices or options. See our Terms and Conditions for details.

values.heading: Call before it's gone.
